title: nameplates
summary: MSUI's overhead identity stack now consumes one law for the selection-circle palette and its first-priority 1 Hz red-to-orange auto-attack pulse, player <AFK><DND><GM> flag decorations, creature <Subname> lines, 1:1 line pitch, selection rescue, and current Benilla's close-fixed/far-proportional world pitch. Ordinary overhead names are camera-facing ImGui-atlas glyph meshes in a late depth-tested, depth-write-off world batch, so terrain and walls occlude them; live V-key plates and chat bubbles suppress that batch and remain separate UI overlays. Enemy/neutral, friendly and all-nameplate modes are independent binding-table commands on V, Shift-V and Ctrl-V, with the same V-plate gate shared by plate drawing, bubble exclusion, quest-marker lift and raid-mark placement. The same palette law paints the ground selection ring.

openItems.text: Names are drawn on the ImGui background draw list, not depth-tested world geometry - walls do not occlude overhead names, where the reference's name batch is depth-test ON
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: WorldNameRenderer builds camera-facing glyph meshes from the live ImGui atlas, submits them after liquid with depth test on and depth writes off, and restores every mutated GL state. GameLoop separately gates ordinary names from V-key plates/chat bubbles, preserves selection rescue and applies Benilla's uncapped distance pitch. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: NPC subname line missing: the creature-query subname (<Stable Master>) is cached but the overhead block renders only the name line
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: GameLoop.Nameplates reads CreatureQueryInfo.Subname and NameplateUiLaw emits the non-empty second line as <Subname> at the reference 1:1 line pitch.

openItems.text: Player AFK/DND/GM prefixes from PLAYER_FLAGS (<AFK><DND><GM> concatenated before the name) are not rendered
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: NameplateUiLaw reads PLAYER_FLAGS bits 0x2/0x4/0x8 and concatenates <AFK><DND><GM> in slot order directly before the player name.

openItems.text: The combat-flash red-orange pulse (first-priority branch of the shared color selector) is applied to the selection ring but not to the overhead name color
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The ground ring and overhead name now call the same NameplateUiLaw.SelectionRgb selector; an active attack target takes its first-priority G-byte 128-to-0-to-128 triangle over red/orange.

openItems.text: Focused nameplate and binding checks plus the full interface suite pass. Live-verify V enemy/neutral, Shift-V friendly, Ctrl-V all toggle semantics after rebind/save/reload, including bubble exclusion, quest-marker lift and plate-vs-raid-mark placement.

Live-verify ordinary player/NPC names disappear behind terrain, buildings and foreground units while V-key plates remain overlay geometry; verify close/far pitch, AFK/DND/GM prefixes, NPC subnames, selection rescue, first-person own-name suppression, bubbles, waterlines and combat-flash colour.
